results.title: Blöde Kuh
results.overview: In a remote mountain setting, Nina tries to balance the fine line between her daughter Jana’s need for affection and her prepubescent attempts for independence, giving her the freedom she desires without losing their connection to each other. But without the comforts of their usual life, tensions between mother and daughter arise as they struggle between the need for closeness and the desire for independence.

results.title: The Static
results.overview: A disturbed teenager finds herself questioning reality.

results.title: Other Distant Mornings
results.overview: Personal footage and abstract imagery intertwine in a fractured poem on love and loss.

results.title: Goodbye Postman
results.overview: Stefan, Markus, and Dieter are among the last postmen of their kind – some have been doing the job for nearly half a century. At Kronberg’s delivery hub, they see how letters are getting smaller, parcels are getting bigger, and their familiar working world is gradually disappearing. Although scanners and efficiency targets now set the pace, they hold fast to their professional ethos: the route doesn’t end until the deliveries are all made. Because there are familiar faces at every drop-off point.

results.title: Gabe's Sister
results.overview: Two young siblings get ready for their dad's anniversary church service while navigating unspoken tensions in the household.

results.title: The Marist Children
results.overview: Hundreds of young boys spent some of the most formative years of their youth at the Marist boarding school in Mindelheim. Everyday life seemed normal and routine: a short walk across the street to school, lunch in the dining hall, free time, study time, dinner and table prayers. But after an abuse scandal could no longer be covered up, the school closed its doors. Today it is clear: for decades, the headmaster had been abusing young boys there. What really happened behind the walls of the Marist Order, where one of the largest church scandals took place? And why isn’t the perpetrator already behind bars?

results.title: Acht Eimer Hühnerherzen »film«
results.overview: To mark the 10th anniversary of the Kreuzberg band Acht Eimer Hühnerherzen, the film offers a charming and honest look into touring, concerts and the small moments in between. The result is an unpretentious portrait of the friendship between three completely different characters, underscored by powerviolence, roaming guitar punk and atmospheric images of highway rest areas, journeys, clubs and moments on stage. The trio provides an intimate look both at absurd situations and the everyday reality of band life, while staying true to their attitude of questioning themselves and never taking themselves too seriously.

results.title: Transferatu
results.overview: Viktor and his young female companion Luna have been living in Berlin for over 100 years. They are junkies, kept going by drugs, blood, and art. They have no fixed sexual orientation, living without sexual intercourse. Young male drug dealers are their primary victims, who end up dying as they orgasm. Klaus is their manager and chauffeur, constantly at their beck and call. He utilizes the dead bodies, selling them for transplant purposes. He loves old American films about exploitation, personally embodying their characters. When Vlad, Viktor’s father, disinherits his son due to his drug addiction, their excesses escalate. Viktor becomes captivated by Mandy, a trans woman. Luna joins them, and in a sensual frenzy, they merge with Mandy until dawn breaks.

results.title: La meute en réseau
results.overview: The web was meant to be a sanctuary of free expression. For many women, it has instead become a nightmare. Three times more likely than men to face death threats, rape threats and online smear campaigns, they are increasingly targeted by coordinated attacks designed to silence them and drive them out of the digital public sphere. Exhausted by this relentless abuse, many eventually choose to leave. Featuring testimonies from Marlène Schiappa, Ève Gilles, Élise Bordet and Laura Loock.

results.title: Les nouveaux influenceurs, quand le savoir devient viral
results.original_title: Les nouveaux influenceurs, quand le savoir devient viral

results.title: Charbel: The Movie
results.overview: When Youssef Makhlouf was born in 1828, the small northern Lebanese village of BeqaaKafra had no idea it was welcoming a future saint. Saint Charbel would go on to bless and heal people of all religions, all around the world. This is simply the biopic of Charbel, the Saint of all Saints!

results.title: Daylight: A Twilight story
results.overview: Aless, an adaptive teenage girl discovers the wonders of the Twilight saga and becomes obsessed with it.

results.title: Resider
results.overview: When something goes bump in the night Adam fears he may not be alone in his new apartment. Whatever is residing within his walls, it seems to want out.

results.title: Hop-Nation
results.overview: In a near-future dystopia set inside 22nd-century's Portugal, a Leader and a Court Jester face off with the future of the new regime at stake. Inspired by Edgar Allan Poe's short-story.

results.title: Case File 427-26
results.overview: A sister brings her brother to see the unfinished house she's moving into. Still under construction and eerily quiet, the property harbors an unsettling presence that neither can explain.

results.title: Act of Love
results.overview: Narrated by Maria Falcone, this documentary reflects on thirty years of civil engagement following the 1992 Capaci massacre. Through archival footage, personal memories, and the historical work of the Falcone Foundation, the film explores how a tragic loss transformed into a nationwide movement for justice, keeping the legacy and dreams of Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino alive for future generations.
